goals: Verify the successful loading and availability of the application's homepage under simulated user load.
Verify the successful loading and availability of specific wallet dashboards for various wallet addresses under simulated user load.
activities: Initialize a data reader for wallet information.
Retrieve a list of miner wallet addresses.
Send an HTTP GET request to the root URL (homepage).
Randomly select a wallet address from the retrieved list.
Send an HTTP GET request to the dashboard URL for the selected wallet.
Update data using the wallet reader.
Retrieve miner payment statistics for the selected wallet.
Check the HTTP response status code of the dashboard request.
Log an error if the dashboard request was not successful.
